name: Quest Lodge v1 — Live interior vs Tutorial Island interior reference
right_label: CRAFTED REALM LIVE GAME, ROOF CUT AWAY
subtitle: Hall of notices: quest board with lantern and lectern, runner rug, chart turret, ledger plinth, bench and scroll rack
review_note: With the roof cut away the hall reads as a story room: the pinned board under its lantern anchors the north wall, the blue-and-red runner leads the eye from the porch door to it, the chart turret opens off the north-west corner, and the ledger, bench and scroll rack fill the reading corner at player scale. Held below 9.0: the plank floor is uniform, the banners are flat panels, and the turret is a viewing bay rather than a room, so the chart is studied from its mouth.
improve: Add worn floor patches at the door thresholds, give the banners fringe and a rod cap, and widen the turret to a true 3-tile bay when the pad is revised.
